image.description: An n-D `Tensor` with at least 3 dimensions, the last 3 of which are the dimensions of each image.
constraints: The shape of `image` has at least 3 dimensions.
If the shape of `image` has fewer than 3 dimensions, a ValueError will be raised.

output.description: A `Tensor` with the same shape as `image` and its dtype is `float32`.
